description: The full launch record of a Solana wallet from our own live recording: how many tokens it deployed, how many reached the exchange, its graduation rate against measured base rates, and whether it is a serial minter with no survivors. Data no feed reconstructs. Flags serial_minter, never_graduated. Facts and flags only, never advice. Free tier: 3 calls per hour per IP, shared with the website; unlimited access costs $0.030 per call over x402 at /v1/deployer
